name: codex-dsh-bridge
description: Local Codex bridge for dispatching work to DeepSeek Harness sessions, with settings inside Harness.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch local tasks to DeepSeek Harness
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the local DeepSeek Harness Web API so Codex can create sessions, send tasks, wait for completion, and read results. Its endpoint and enabled state can be managed from Harness Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration.
defaultPrompt: 把这个项目中的一个子任务派发给 DSH。
列出当前项目对应的 DSH 会话。
等待 DSH 会话完成并读取结果。
